findings.title: The not-bound stderr line was never asserted
findings.action: Capture stderr and assert the line
findings.disposition_rationale: 6c9e054a captures stderr and asserts exactly one not-bound line.

findings.title: No test showed the roll-up receives the ruling without its binding
findings.action: Export the read as a helper and test it
findings.disposition_rationale: 6c9e054a moves the read into exported readBoundRuling; a test asserts no binding key and verdict-only fields.

findings.title: Inline entry.ruling keeps a model-written binding and is not identity-checked
findings.action: Strip the inline copy and check finding_id
findings.disposition_rationale: 0ccf4549 strips a model binding from the inline copy (tested). The identity half is refuted: admitBuildRollup keys on case_id and outcome, and the floor uses entry.finding_id, so a model-echoed finding_id is never read.

findings.title: A crash between the sweep and the first ledger write leaves old ledger with no rulings
findings.disposition_rationale: That state fails closed (--admit exits 2, park), which is the intended direction; the spec orders the sweep before the case and ledger writes.
